releaseNotes:
Update v1.2.10:

1. PDF Viewer: Restored one-tap Save File button with direct copy to App Library.
2. Office Suite: Word (.docx) to PDF pure Dart offline export and in-app document viewing enhancements.
3. Scanner & OCR: Document scanning with edge detection, interactive crop, and text recognition capabilities.
4. Stability & Security: Enhanced provider lifecycle management, encrypted vault storage fixes, and bug fixes.
